title: Windows: Files tab + peer-to-peer update propagation
highlights: Windows: brand-new Files tab. Pick a connected device, choose a file, and watch chunked transfer progress in real time. Backed by the FileOffer / FileChunk / FileAck protocol Mac has used since 0.1.30, so Mac ↔ Windows transfers work out of the box.

Windows: peer-to-peer update propagation. Drop Entanglo-Setup-<version>.exe into %LocalAppData%\Entanglo\Updates\ (or click Install on a peer) and every connected Entanglo peer receives the installer over TCP with a 10-second countdown dialog.
Windows: cleanup at launch — obsolete Entanglo-Setup-<version>.exe files older than the running build are deleted from the outbox and downloads folders so old installers don't pile up.
Windows: Install button now pushes to all connected peers before running the local installer, mirroring the Mac beginInstall flow.
